albums.description: List of album configurations, each with files, titles, and optional per-language captions per file

albums.files.description: List of image files in the album (relative or absolute paths)

albums.files.caption.description: Single-language caption for the image (used if no langs defined)

albums.files.captions.description: List of captions, one per language (used if langs defined)

albums.langs.description: List of language identifiers (e.g., 'en', 'es') for multi-language captions

albums.title.description: Title of the album; if omitted, 'Untitled' is used
